meta.source: Brand Guide v2.1.2 (approved 2026-09-30), visual identity carried from Brand Lock v1.3 §6

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page ground. The brand is light-mode only (Brand Guide v2.1.2 §11).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, on white (19.91:1) and lilac (13.99:1). Never a brand colour for paragraphs.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Tinted surfaces: cards, section bands. Never text on white.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Logo colour; headings or large accents on white (7.44:1).

tokens.name: deep-blue
tokens.usage: Logo colour; headings or accents on white (8.95:1) and lilac (6.29:1).

tokens.name: plum-deep
tokens.usage: Gradient start; data callouts and headings on white (10.88:1).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Gradient end; secondary text on white (7.78:1).

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Links, small accents, active states and the primary button fill. On white 7.80:1, on lilac 5.48:1. Never paragraphs, never error.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links — alias of magenta.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on the gradient and on any brand-colour fill (7.44–10.88:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icons, borders, large text only (3.30:1 on white).

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text at normal size (5.02:1 on white).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons, borders, large text only (3.19:1).

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text at normal size (5.02:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error icons and borders (4.83:1).

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: Error text (6.47:1). Never use magenta for errors.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: bylines, sources, captions. On white 9.71:1, on lilac 6.82:1.

tokens.name: lilac-soft
tokens.usage: Inner panel inside a lilac or white card (guess slider). Ink on it 17.32:1.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the empty part of mini-visuals. Decorative only (1.3:1 on lilac): never the only carrier of meaning.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One family: Source Sans 3 on the web, Myriad Pro in print. Never Inter or Montserrat.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Nous mesurons, nous entraînons, nous re-mesurons.
styles.usage: One per page: hero titles, on white or on the gradient.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Ce qui se passe pendant une séance

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Le cerveau apprend par retour d'information, comme un musicien qui s'accorde en écoutant sa note.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Premier pas : un rendez-vous téléphonique gratuit et sans engagement.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: The one data callout per view, in plum-deep.

spacing.note: Only these steps (Brand Lock hard rule 9).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and tight controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps in a card grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding; between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Slide margins; large hero padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Poster and cover margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, the logo badge corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and image frames — airy, rounded.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and status chips.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control. Never removed (hard rule 7).

tokens.name: card-soft
tokens.usage: Optional lift for a white card on white. Lilac cards need none.
